### Option 1 (Professional & LinkedIn Style)

**Complete AI PoE Switch Portfolio — Reliable Connectivity for Smart Networks**

Our comprehensive AI PoE switch series is designed to meet diverse deployment requirements, from small edge devices to large-scale surveillance and industrial applications.

🔹 **Multiple Port Options**  
Available in 5, 6, 10, 18, and 26-port configurations for flexible network expansion.

🔹 **Smart AI Features**  
Support AI Extend mode for long-distance PoE transmission, improving deployment flexibility.

🔹 **Stable PoE Power Supply**  
Reliable power and data transmission for IP cameras, wireless APs, IP phones, and IoT devices.

🔹 **Plug & Play Deployment**  
Unmanaged design enables quick installation and simple operation with minimal maintenance.

🔹 **Ideal for Various Scenarios**  
Perfect for CCTV surveillance, smart buildings, commercial networks, and industrial environments.

**Power your intelligent network with a reliable PoE solution.**

#PoESwitch #AIPoE #NetworkSwitch #CCTV #IPCamera #SmartBuilding #IndustrialNetworking

---

### Option 2（更偏营销，适合吸引客户）

**One Series. Multiple Choices. Unlimited Possibilities.**

From compact 5-port models to high-density 26-port solutions, our AI PoE Switch family delivers the flexibility and reliability required by modern IP networks.

✔ Flexible port configurations  
✔ Long-range AI PoE transmission  
✔ Stable power & data delivery  
✔ Easy plug-and-play installation  
✔ Ideal for CCTV, Wi-Fi AP and IoT deployments

**Build smarter, simpler, and more reliable networks with our AI PoE Switch solutions.**

#PoESwitch #AIoT #CCTV #Networking #EthernetSwitch

---

如果是发**B2B外贸客户（LinkedIn获客）**，我更推荐**Option 1**，因为它更像产品方案介绍，容易让系统集成商、分销商和项目商理解产品价值。

### Option 1 (Professional & Solution-Oriented)

**Smart Managed PoE Switch — Full Control, Greater Network Visibility**

Our managed PoE switch series provides intelligent network management, flexible configuration, and real-time monitoring for demanding enterprise and industrial applications.

🔹 **Comprehensive Web Management**  
User-friendly GUI for easy configuration, monitoring, and maintenance.

🔹 **Advanced Layer 2 Features**  
Support VLAN, Link Aggregation, STP/RSTP, ERPS, Multicast, and MAC address management.

🔹 **Real-Time Network Monitoring**  
Monitor system status, port information, CPU, and memory usage for proactive maintenance.

🔹 **Reliable PoE Power Management**  
Intelligent PoE control ensures stable power delivery to IP cameras, wireless APs, and other PoE devices.

🔹 **Built for Critical Networks**  
Ideal for industrial automation, CCTV surveillance, smart transportation, and enterprise applications.

**Gain greater control, visibility, and reliability with our managed PoE switching solutions.**

#ManagedSwitch #PoESwitch #IndustrialEthernet #NetworkManagement #CCTV #SmartCity #FiberOptics

---

### Option 2 (More LinkedIn Marketing Style)

**Manage Smarter. Operate Easier. Stay Connected.**

A reliable network requires more than connectivity — it requires complete visibility and control.

✔ Intuitive web-based management interface  
✔ VLAN & traffic optimization  
✔ Link redundancy and network protection  
✔ Real-time system monitoring  
✔ Intelligent PoE management  

**Designed for stable, efficient, and scalable Ethernet networks.**

#EthernetSwitch #ManagedSwitch #PoE #Networking #IndustrialNetwork

---

这个产品我建议 **突出“管理功能”而不是单纯说交换机参数**，因为从界面看你的优势正是：
- Web GUI  
- VLAN  
- ERPS 环网  
- STP  
- Link Aggregation  
- Multicast  
- PoE 管理  

这类关键词对**系统集成商、工业自动化客户、安防工程商**更有吸引力。

### Option 1 (Professional & Technical Style)

**High-Capacity DCI P2P Solution — Enabling Long-Distance 400G Data Center Interconnection**

Our DCI Point-to-Point solution delivers ultra-high bandwidth, low latency, and reliable optical transmission for modern data center networks.

🔹 **400G Coherent Transmission**  
Support high-speed 400G coherent CFP2 technology, enabling efficient long-haul optical transport.

🔹 **Large Capacity Expansion**  
Up to 40-channel DWDM MUX/DEMUX architecture, maximizing fiber utilization and network scalability.

🔹 **Long-Distance Connectivity**  
Designed for 100 km transmission with optical amplification solutions to ensure stable signal performance.

🔹 **High Availability Architecture**  
Main and backup fiber links provide redundancy and improve network reliability.

🔹 **Seamless Data Center Interconnection**  
Ideal for data centers, cloud networks, telecom operators, and high-capacity backbone applications.

**Build scalable, resilient, and future-ready DCI networks with advanced 400G optical solutions.**

#DCI #DWDM #400G #OpticalNetworking #DataCenter #FiberOptics #Telecom #NetworkInfrastructure

---

### Option 2 (More Marketing-Oriented)

**Connecting Data Centers at the Speed of 400G**

As data traffic continues to grow, reliable and scalable DCI solutions become essential. Our 400G DWDM P2P solution provides high-capacity transmission over long distances with superior efficiency.

✔ 400G coherent optical technology  
✔ 40-channel DWDM capacity expansion  
✔ 100 km long-distance transmission  
✔ Main & backup link protection  
✔ Flexible deployment for modern data centers

**Powering the next generation of cloud and AI-driven network infrastructure.**

#400G #DCI #DWDM #CloudComputing #AIInfrastructure #OpticalTransport

---

如果你的目标客户是**运营商、数据中心集成商、海外电信设备商**，我会更推荐 **Option 1**，技术点更明确，容易体现你们做 **DWDM / DCI 传输方案** 的专业性。

### Option 1 (Professional & Technical Style)

**AC Powered Fiber Media Converter — Reliable Single-mode & Multi-mode Fiber Connectivity**

Our AC powered fiber media converters provide a simple and cost-effective solution for extending Ethernet networks over optical fiber, supporting seamless conversion between single-mode and multi-mode environments.

🔹 **Single-mode & Multi-mode Conversion**  
Support flexible fiber type conversion to meet diverse network deployment requirements.

🔹 **Stable AC Power Design**  
Built-in AC power supply enables direct connection to AC sources without external adapters.

🔹 **Long-Distance Ethernet Extension**  
Extend copper Ethernet transmission over fiber for greater distance and enhanced reliability.

🔹 **Compact Metal Housing**  
Industrial-grade metal enclosure offers excellent heat dissipation and durable operation.

🔹 **Wide Application Scenarios**  
Ideal for enterprise networks, CCTV surveillance, campus networks, telecom systems, and industrial communication.

**Bridge the gap between copper and fiber with a reliable and efficient media conversion solution.**

#FiberMediaConverter #FiberOptics #SingleMode #MultiMode #Ethernet #CCTV #IndustrialNetworking #OpticalCommunication

---

### Option 2 (More LinkedIn Marketing Style)

**Simple Fiber Conversion. Stable Network Connection.**

Designed for flexible fiber deployments, our AC powered media converters ensure reliable Ethernet extension between single-mode and multi-mode optical networks.

✔ Single-mode / Multi-mode fiber conversion  
✔ Built-in AC power supply  
✔ Long-distance optical transmission  
✔ Compact metal design  
✔ Easy installation and maintenance  

**A cost-effective solution for stable and scalable fiber network expansion.**

#MediaConverter #FiberNetwork #OpticalTransmission #EthernetNetwork #Telecom #NetworkSolution

### Option 1 (Professional & Technical Style)

**Optical Bypass Switch — Ensuring Network Continuity and Zero Downtime**

Our optical bypass switch is designed to protect critical fiber links by automatically maintaining optical connectivity during equipment failures or power outages.

🔹 **Automatic Fiber Protection**  
Instantly switches the optical path to bypass failed equipment, ensuring uninterrupted network transmission.

🔹 **Low Insertion Loss**  
High-performance optical design minimizes signal attenuation and maintains excellent transmission quality.

🔹 **Fail-Safe Operation**  
Supports automatic bypass during power loss, providing reliable protection for mission-critical networks.

🔹 **Compact & Flexible Deployment**  
Small form factor with easy integration into existing optical systems and network architectures.

🔹 **Ideal for Critical Applications**  
Widely used in telecom networks, data centers, optical transport systems, and industrial fiber communication.

**Keep your optical network always online with intelligent bypass protection.**

#OpticalBypass #FiberOptics #NetworkReliability #DataCenter #Telecom #OpticalNetwork #FiberCommunication

---

### Option 2 (More Marketing-Oriented)

**Protect Your Fiber Network. Minimize Downtime.**

When network availability matters, every second counts. Our Optical Bypass Switch automatically redirects the optical signal around failed equipment, ensuring continuous communication and improved network resilience.

✔ Automatic fail-safe optical switching  
✔ Ultra-low insertion loss  
✔ Fast response during equipment failure  
✔ Compact and easy-to-deploy design  
✔ Suitable for telecom, data center and industrial networks

**A simple solution for stronger, smarter, and more reliable optical infrastructure.**

#OpticalSwitch #OpticalBypass #DWDM #FiberNetwork #IndustrialNetworking

---

这类产品在 LinkedIn 上我会更推荐 **Option 1**，因为 Optical Bypass 的客户（运营商、数据中心、系统集成商）更关注 **protection、fail-safe、network availability、zero downtime** 这些关键词，比单纯强调参数更容易吸引专业客户。
